text:
Maria (eng-platform): Heads up — invoice preview just showed ~14k "ghost" token credits for a subset of tenants after the soft-fail TTL change. Anyone else seeing this?
Kevin (billing): saw the spike in preview yesterday, flagged as "preview-only" but the numbers line up with late-arriving events.
Sasha (eng-infra): that sounds like the new soft-fail grace window we rolled last week. We increased TTL from 30s -> 90s for the routing proxy fallback.
Tony (console): is the console aggregating preview and finalized metrics differently? the preview dashboards show the bump but finalized invoices did not.
Maria (eng-platform): exactly — preview uses immediate ingest stream, invoices use finalizer job that waits on watermark. If graceful replays create dupes in preview we won't see them in finalizer unless dedupe keys differ.
Kevin (billing): can we confirm whether dedupe key is stable across retry paths? if the proxy attaches a new request id we could double-count in preview.
Sasha (eng-infra): digging — quick event example from logs:
```
{"tenant":"acme","req_id":"r123","routing_fingerprint":"fp-42","tokens":120,"event_ts":1680000000}
```
On retry the proxy was adding `req_id=r123-retry` which changed the dedupe envelope.
Maria (eng-platform): ugh. so preview shows both r123 and r123-retry in the streaming aggregator. finalizer canonicalizes on `routing_fingerprint` so dedupe works there.
Tony (console): from UX side this is confusing for customers: invoice preview suggests a spike and the preview alert fires. We need either de-duped preview or a note/annotation in the dashboard when soft-fail TTL is on.
Kevin (billing): agreed. customers complain. Can we suppress preview alerts for tenants with recent TTL changes? temporary workaround.
Sasha (eng-infra): short-term patch: make streaming aggregator prefer `routing_fingerprint` as primary dedupe key if present, fallback to `req_id` otherwise. That should collapse the duplicate. I can PR today.
Maria (eng-platform): 👍 do we have test coverage for late-joiner duplicates? I think the canary didn't exercise retry id mutation.
Sasha (eng-infra): no, missed that. I'll add a harness scenario that simulates proxy adding `-retry` suffix and assert aggregator dedupes by fingerprint.
Tony (console): longer-term: can the console show an "in-flight TTL" tag on preview graphs and wire a small tooltip explaining preview vs finalizer semantics? Product asked for that last quarter.
Maria (eng-platform): good idea — Tony, can you mock the tooltip copy? short: "Preview aggregates streaming events; final invoices are deduplicated by canonical routing_fingerprint and watermarking."
Tony (console): will draft.
Kevin (billing): ask: what about the canary rollout? can we roll back TTL change for a narrow cohort while we fix aggregator?
Sasha (eng-infra): yes — rollback knob is per-route. I'll revert for the affected region/tenant set and re-run canary with the dedupe patch.
IngestBot: [alert] streaming-aggregator: duplicate-detection-rate increased by 3.2x in region-us-west-2 at 2026-03-21T18:02:12Z
Maria (eng-platform): timeline: Sasha rolls revert for cohort, PR for dedupe by fingerprint lands, QA harness added, Tony pushes tooltip. Kevin: Communicate to ops/customer-facing that preview numbers may fluctuate during this maintenance window.
Kevin (billing): copying to #support to pre-empt tickets. :pray:
Sasha (eng-infra): I'll create the PR and tag y'all. Estimated fix + verification 4 hours.
Maria (eng-platform): thanks. If anyone sees unexpected finalizer spikes after revert call it out immediately.
Tony (console): will put a small banner on the preview dashboard: "Preview may include transient duplicates during routing TTL experiments."
Maria (eng-platform): ok closing loop — follow-ups: Sasha PR link, Tony banner text, Kevin to notify support. Keep thread updates here.
